## What do you want?

A clear description of the feature or improvement.

## Why?

What problem does this solve? How would it improve your content workflow?

## Suggested approach

If you have ideas on how this could work, describe them here. (Optional — we'll figure it out together if not.)

## Would you contribute this?

- [ ] Yes — I'd like to build this and submit a PR
- [ ] Maybe — I could help test it
- [ ] No — just suggesting
